source.title: What catatonia can tell us about "top-down modulation": a neuropsychiatric hypothesis

confidence_rationale: The canonical clinical mechanism account of catatonia. It is scored mixed for MECH-535 because it does two things at once: it confirms that the dominant account locates the catatonic deficit in top-down modulation and movement TERMINATION (an excess-persistence framing, the opposite pole from MECH-535's no-persistence oscillation) and never in the goal representation, which leaves the representational route MECH-535 registers genuinely un-owned; and it attributes the one ambitendency-like vignette it contains (a patient standing for days before a wardrobe, 'blockade of my will ... since I couldn't decide') to a volitional blockade, not to a representational deficit. Source quality is high for a theoretical target article; mapping fidelity is moderate because the article does not discuss ambitendency as a sign at all.
failure_signatures: Northoff's ball experiments (32 acute akinetic patients) show catatonic patients can plan, initiate and execute movements but cannot TERMINATE them: the clinical akinesia is a termination failure with persistence in excess, not a failure to hold a course.
The word 'ambitendency' does not occur in the target article; the model has no explicit account of the approach/withdraw sign.

The wardrobe vignette (days of standing before the wardrobe, 'contradictory and ambivalent thoughts ... I couldn't decide myself') is the article's closest ambitendency case and is a lorazepam NON-responder, read by Northoff as a blockade of will.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Catatonia is a disorder of 'top-down modulation': GABA-A-mediated deficits in orbitofrontal / medial prefrontal cortex alter 'vertical modulation' of caudate and other basal ganglia (accounting for motor signs), and altered orbitofrontal-prefrontal/parietal cortico-cortical connectivity ('horizontal modulation') accounts for emotional and behavioural signs. Catatonic patients 'are well able to plan, initiate, and execute movements' but 'remained in a final posture ... apparently unable to change posture and terminate the respective movement'; right posterior parietal function is proposed as necessary 'for on-line monitoring and consecutive termination of movements'. Parkinson's disease, by contrast, is a 'bottom-up' striatal dopaminergic deficit with impaired initiation.
mapping.ree_translation: In REE terms Northoff locates the catatonic deficit in the control plane (OFC/mPFC top-down modulation of the BG selection loop, i.e. the commitment/termination machinery of MECH-202 and ARC-107), not in what the state representation carries. MECH-535's route III is therefore not a restatement of the clinical model; it is orthogonal to it. Northoff's termination-failure reading (posture held against gravity because the movement cannot be ended) is a persistence-EXCESS pathology, the perseveration pole of MECH-536's prediction, whereas 978's ambitendency is a persistence-ABSENCE pathology; both produce a stationary phenotype (stupor / boundary-press) but by opposite dynamics.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Northoff never discusses ambitendency as a sign, so the null on 'goal-in-valence-not-direction' is a null of omission, not a considered rejection. His right-parietal 'on-line monitoring' component is a spatial-representation element, but it concerns the representation of one's OWN body position (motor anosognosia), not the representation of goal direction. The article is a hypothesis paper built on small patient series (n=10-32) and SPECT/neuropsychology; it is not a test of any REE mechanism.
mapping.source_context: Human clinical neuropsychiatry; acute akinetic catatonia vs Parkinson's disease; ball-catching/throwing experiments, SPECT, neuropsychology, movement-related cortical potentials; theoretical target article with open peer commentary.

confidence_components.notes: High-quality theoretical synthesis by the field's principal mechanistic theorist, but the mapping to MECH-535 is indirect: the article's value is in fixing WHERE the existing account puts the deficit (control/termination) so the representational route can be seen as distinct. Transfer risk is high because human catatonia involves affective and autonomic dimensions with no analogue in the 978 reader.
